mapping: native id preserved as raw_id; new project qid = mragb:<raw_id>; explicit official export maps qs_id back to raw_id. Legacy two-fixture mode retains original raw qids only for backward compatibility.
scoring_answers: external nonempty JSON list: qid, answer_choice, scenario; defines fixed question set
predictions: JSONL: qid, raw_output:string, generation_error:null or nonempty string

parser.accepted: after surrounding whitespace removal, exactly uppercase A-D, (A)-(D), or fullwidth-parenthesis equivalents

failure_policy: empty, parse failure, generation error and missing count as incorrect
coverage: received records / fixed question count, includes recorded generation errors
model_boundary: Only model_request and resolved image bytes, never paths/condition/source/answers, reach future adapter.
synthetic: fixed_A_v1 flagged predictions and scores remain external and separate by condition
A_result_schema: B-native results add prediction_raw, prediction, extraction_method=strict_choice_v1, parser_version and detailed failures. Not claimed to conform to A result schema enum until A accepts these values.
run_batch_id: One id shared by all rows from one run invocation; not a per-row unique id
raw_alias_rule: If both raw_output and prediction_raw exist, require exact equality
S3: Only interface declarations D1/D2; undetermined => diagnostic_only; no percentage threshold
split_policy: Current A full benchmark splits rejected pending exposure reconciliation; fixture qids are not formal splits
